mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, weakening consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in 60% or more of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals housing sector weakness, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when HOUST declines during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% (derived from CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, triggering expectations of monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales index (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
